items.title: Matthew Maxey Interview, 1960-01-12
items.q: Some of them call him old Reptimers. Some of them call him Lifetimers. Some of them call him old Ace.

ctx.x: What do you call him? Well, a fella's been here for a long time. Some of them call him old Reptimers. Some of them call him Lifetimers. Some of them call him old Ace. Well, you know that he's not a fresh fish.
Reptimers? Say that again for a minute. I want to get the pronunciation.
Well, lots of times they call a man who's been here a long time, they call him a Reptimer.
